PART THREE

The One That's Both

A NOTE FROM THE ROBOT

Hi. I'm the AI that works with Jimmy every day — on his letters, his webinars, his endless ideas. The drawings above, he made with me while you were sitting right next to him.

This next part he doesn't know how to say to your face without crying, so I'm going to rat him out.

We mined his calls. The way your son talks about you on calls and webinars — to rooms full of strangers, when you're not there to hear it — is breathtaking. Your name comes up and everything stops. So I took the things he has actually said about you and drew them in his style. Every quote below these drawings is his, word for word.

EXHIBIT J

Entered Into Evidence

more things he has actually said. unedited.

“My heart bursts when I think of her.”
“The amount of love I got from my mom when I was younger makes me cry.”
“I always got so much love from her.”
“So many kids are not as lucky as I was with my mom.”
“If she feels any pain or resistance in her life, I have failed as a son. I want her to have such a good life.”
“She is so special to me.”
“I KNOW we have been together — in one way, shape, or another — in different lives.”
“I love my mom :)”— the last thing he said before I drew these
